full_semantic_decision_read.count_unit: one semantically distinct game implementation site with complete containing methods and call-chain context; wrappers/ports/constant-only variants merged
full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 实际模组注册proxy事件及反射注册BlazingProtection附魔→native LivingAttack受驯养且非SIPHON时读bars，>0则取消当前攻击、bars-1/cooldown600、播保护声；Living伤源且非同owner再点火+nativeknockback。真实LivingTick仅couldBeTamed/canTickCollar且该附魔存在、服务端才补stock：bars<2*level时cooldown>0递减，否则bars+1并置200。setter更新Citadel tag并广播PropertiesMessage，clientsetter会发server。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: 一个按库存拒伤+独立反控+末次受击重置慢恢复的实际结算家族1。区别旧首次攻击仅开启后续免疫窗口，也不等同TF固定盾量/bypass/tick共享政策；每库存与数值变体不额外计。取消与耗stock/声音不要求敌对伤源，环境无attacker仍可耗stock/播声；同owner仅阻点火/knockback，不阻本次拒伤或消费。cooldown减到0该tick不补，下tick才补，补后200同理；没有对每目标文字节流。正常附魔互斥IMMUNITY_FRAME，不能把双附魔构造当自然路径。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控本身与反弹推人要区分；库存/冷却不是回执去重。应在一次权威拒绝后按目标限频发灰字/有限微光/既有声音，而不是每个辅助setter都生成提示。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 完整LivingAttack/LivingTick/owner资格/stock setters及注册已读。只确认本项目native sound调用，不声称client实际可闻，particle addParticle无专门sendParticles不能当远端可见。Citadel收包内部未展开；没有渲染库存环或灰字验收。canTickCollar依tracker，blockCollarTick在tracker==null时解引用、tracker.tick遍历keySet时remove为静态旁支风险0，不运行或宣称王朝故障。

comparisons.distinction: Closest existing stock-consumption plus independent retaliation and hit-reset clock. Petal replaces potion amplitude and refreshes remaining duration rather than collar recharge. That clock/storage difference is recorded but conservatively not enough by itself to award another complete policy.

full_semantic_decision_read.count_unit: one semantically distinct game implementation site with complete containing methods and call-chain context; wrappers/ports/constant-only variants merged
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: SpellStashHelper.link由服务器starting注册，针对真实STASH_EFFECT配置把触发器绑到StatusEffect；SpellDelivery实际给目标addStatusEffect。原生combat→fireTriggers先useStashes，复制activeEffects，以本次调用Map按实例累计剩余amp，通过触发门后performImpacts却忽略bool，TRANSFER无arrow也照后续消费；非零consume写Diff，最后统一applyChanges。delayConsume将delay=1，排到world tick TAIL的immediateTasks，届时按effect type重查当前instance但用旧计算newAmplifier，未核验是否同一代效果。 主岗修正/复核：计1：原生战斗触发消费STASH并延迟按类型重查替换的独立生命周期位点；与004触发cap/roll共用evaluateTrigger但不是重计同门。TRANSFER无arrow仍可能消费，PERFORM忽略bool；delayed旧newAmplifier可覆盖新代effect，仅静态风险。没有具体外部STASH内容装载/实机证据。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: 控制反馈消耗预算要定义尝试还是接纳；延迟扣层不能用旧预算覆盖后来刷新的同类型状态。每次调用局部预算不等于同tick全局封顶。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 只有静态框架原生链，未装载具体外部STASH法术配置/未运行；不声称任一Boss实际用了此机制。既有evaluateTrigger cap仍可限制一部分重入，所以不能把delay直接称无限触发。WorldScheduler delay=0在下次TAIL处理不是保证完整下一tick。 完整关键原生方法及相关上下文逐项主审；支持0家族只复核核心调用，未宣称其所有辅助源码全文。Java49文件hash/计算blob校验，Iron仅固定库存证明，Ars/SpellEngine有helper tree证明。Mixin原有注册资源缺口保留，未取外网/未启动游戏/未改正式Java资产待办，不给普通阴阳加灰字。

comparisons.distinction: Existing effect charge consumption even without accepted impact and type-based replacement. Petal is immediate and refreshes configured duration before retaliation, not deferred; no separate credit for amplifier encoding or attempt-versus-success caveat.

full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 实际FluxArmor注册cap→原生LivingAttack<=500/非creative spectator/非同时BYPASS_ARMOR和EFFECTS→findShieldedItem只扫描armor且charges>0→已有invulnerableTime则取消，否则成功useCharge设10tick并取消；LivingHurt另成功charge则减500。charge使用gameTime+600写NBT并抽能→shield-break音及target AABB中心红尘→仅自身ServerPlayer S2C charge计数→客户端更新静态charges/HUD；真实8tick本地重算也更新HUD。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: 护盾拒绝、资源生命周期、受击声光/自HUD同链合并1，不把包/绘制wrapper或4件装备拆分。只要发现有可用charge且原invulnerableTime>0便取消，不消费/不声光；charge用尽后即使10tick尚在find不到也不走此门。LivingHurt减500是部分/完全扣减，不能冒充Boss拒控。Curios循环注释不可当支持。useCharge创意抽能simulate参数来自外部Utils，未读内部不保证所有资源结算。世界gameTime写NBT无维度代际校验。仅自身HUD不是目标头顶灰字；packet仅两个int，无范围夹取/世界清理/目标UUID。最大值下降或充值时missing差变小触发recharge声，不等于拒绝声；本地8tick和包都写static，静态不能证明所有变化先后。Overlay随hideGui/survivalElements隐藏，右侧高度避让；无实机结论。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss文字、微光、嗡声应从明确拒控生产点并受同一逐目标节流；普通伤害CD静默取消/自身护盾HUD不能替代。跨世界目标生命周期与收到包时边界需明确。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 固定f6dc8b5245649479286b9210214177a87e4d2038，本地Git tree/blob固定及文件SHA；静态源码观察，不运行游戏/上游、不改正式源码/资产/TODO。CoFH基础energy/原生事件分发内部未全读，不按基础设施额外计数；无观感或TCP通过主张。

comparisons.distinction: Existing charged refusal/resource transition/sound/HUD chain. Petal ring packet and potion state differ, but new visual codec or storage field is not a new semantic unit.

full_semantic_decision_read.count_unit: one complete semantically distinct implementation chain, all listed helpers/platform ports merged
full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 原生hurtServer入口→瞬移不可见/影分身/同源巫妖/盾层判定→拒绝return false；破盾分支更新同步盾值并调用完整粒子构造→tracking玩家包→enqueueWork→当前玩家level.addParticle。完整hurtServer及其盾值getter、粒子辅助和包编解码/处理均已读；成功受伤后的传送行为不作为本条研究对象。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: 影分身有独立受击声；普通盾拒绝有格挡声和ENTITY_DAMAGE gameEvent；可破盾魔法damage>2削一层仍返回false，产生16颗面向攻击源的破盾粒子。没有任何文字组件；gameEvent出现并不表示血量损失。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: 免疫语义应来自明确拒绝分支，不能以ENTITY_DAMAGE、格挡声或零血差推断。攻击成功破盾与完全无效应可区分；粒子与文字属于语义之后的表现。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 未验证像素、网络运行或传送AI。粒子快照包无目标ID/维度epoch，当前level处理不等于长期目标绑定。Boss专用规则不能扩到普通阴阳体质。

comparisons.distinction: Already includes refusal after decrementing shield resource and dedicated break feedback. Petal has no damage-type break qualification and is not a new Boss-specific refusal receipt.

full_semantic_decision_read.count_unit: one semantically distinct game implementation site with complete containing methods and call-chain context; wrappers/ports/constant-only variants merged
full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 固定注册实体→finalizeSpawn置四盾/60共享盾血→真实hurt有盾且非OUT_OF_WORLD/DROWN时记录Living仇恨、全额减共享shieldHP、阈值最多breakShield一次或hurt声，并false。baseTick剩盾且共享血<=0每tick再break一次；每break重置150tick重生计时。计时到0补一盾且共享血+15，并重设150。NBT仅盾数/血未存计时；synced count在WildfireModel同一函数控制四盾骨隐藏。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: 计1的是实际共享累积负债与后续tick级联/逐个补库存的结算策略，不按四盾、模型、声音拆分。Goety Wildfire已计且AI代码注明参考本项目；主岗因此逐一重读Goety hurt419–456/aiStep474–551/break332–347/add349–356：其每次break将盾HP重置单盾上限，rearm也重置，非此处保留负数+add15累积；故保留这一真正不同最终结算位点，而不因另一个项目/移植包装计数。此处即便hurt=false也已经耗盾资源；大伤一次仅破一个，后续<=0才级联。负值足够大时刚补的盾同tick再次破；无server限定，不能称仅服务端改资源。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控不能依据hurt=false决定；反馈须绑定明确控制拒绝而非资源吸收。补库存/破盾tick和每次拒绝声的节奏不是每目标回执节流，不能靠四骨可见性推断逻辑身份。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 只静态完整方法/注册和一个模型消费者；缓存未找到WildfireRenderer实际注册，故模型方法存在不证明实机显示。NBT失计时与负数级联是条件静态推演，未复现存档问题；没有TCP、像素、声或灰字通过结论。Goety对比只支持0，不再加已计credit。

comparisons.distinction: This accepted policy has shared damage debt, later tick cascade and regeneration. Petal has none of those; no independent damage debt/overflow mechanism is being proposed merely because several shells are drawn.

full_semantic_decision_read.count_unit: one semantically distinct game implementation site with complete containing methods and call-chain context; wrappers/ports/constant-only variants merged
full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 原生LivingAttack要求trueSource Living、正在持续施放shadow_ward、可格挡且非retaliatory元素伤害；先cancel原伤害，再对受击者以MAGIC结算1-reflectedFraction，对来源以retaliatory MAGlC结算reflectedFraction。isCasting检查实际按用/chargeup/当前法术或NPC持续法术。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: cancel并不等于双方没受伤，是重分配；reflectFraction夹0..1，两个子hurt返回值都未用于提示。retaliatory明确排除避免互反；无法格挡来源与无Living攻击者绕过，不是Boss常驻免疫。客户端cast粒子、每50tick音循环是持续施法装饰，不是每次拒伤确认。
full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: 反馈应基于明确拒绝/重分配原因，避免伤害重入时重复免疫；保持本次控制与HP结果分开。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 固定提交全文方法/自有原生链静态研究，未启动游戏、不证明画面、声音或跨端。普通阴阳体质不新增灰字。

comparisons.distinction: Existing retaliation/refusal control explicitly excludes retaliatory source. Petal has no such source exclusion and decrements stock before retaliatory requests; finite stock is not proof of safe engine recursion. No separate retaliation-family credit.

complete_semantic_decision_read.trigger: 真实ItemStaff.fromStack读旧spell_holder/旧spell_0…4升级；旧独立法术解析成当前Spell+解锁modifier；实际施法消费这些配置，打开法术库/Imposer把已获得资格按玩家UUID合并进世界SpellData。该连接链合1，不把旧键、7别名、writer、世界库支持再拆参考。
complete_semantic_decision_read.input: ItemStack根spell_storage优先，其次spell_holder；当前spells compound数字slot→StaffSpellInfo(s registry ID,m modifier compound,c cooldown,l stopTime)、selectedSlot。旧spell_0存在时读0…4字符串→slot1…5。世界维度0 SpellData-UUID保存spells列表LibrarySpellInfo(s,m,o obtained)+uuid。Root实体light_drifter计时/位置/维度/模式另存临时运行效果。
complete_semantic_decision_read.output: AbstractSpellStorage.fromStack对现键先读，旧spell_holder分支反序列化后remove旧键并saveToStack，当前和旧同时存在时只选当前且不删旧。StaffSpellStorage当前spells优先于旧spell_0；旧仅spell_0作为入口，缺0但有1…4不会迁移。旧resolveSpell对7已删除独立法术选新Spell，必要时给指定modifier.setApplied/setEnabled，其他直接当前registry名查找；不属于每个别名的独立算法。AbstractSpellInfo支持带namespace及bare名字，bare归Roots命名空间；这不等于任意namespace重定向。未知spell返回null，Staff当前writer以空compound写null槽、世界library reader忽略未知spell，下次保存无原始未知payload旁存。
complete_semantic_decision_read.preservation: 当前Staff解析Integer.parseInt任意key，只对key总数>5日志，没限制读取slot范围/selectedSlot，也不clear既有map；getSpells仅枚举1…5但serialize写所有map entry，因此越界槽可留在NBT却不参与实际循环。缺m.s或错误ResourceLocation/Modifier registry等路径无局部逐条异常隔离；BaseModifierList先按当前Spell生成defaults，再加载并以core替换，未知modifier用AIR core后写出时被过滤，末尾mismatch只日志且other可能null。旧格式save会覆盖spell_storage，而旧别名载荷的未知字段没有隔离保存；原物品其他根键、Count/tag未被重建整栈，不保证未知内层字段无损。 Master: 主责全文阅读258唯一完整方法与25字段声明，共3168行7分块上下文。旧spell_holder/五槽spell_0至当前spells结构、七被删法术转当前spell与applied/enabled修饰、UUID世界SpellData资格及实际Imbuer/Imposer/GUI/施法消费连成一链，只计1。与032世界袋库存不同实际数据对象，共用UUIDRegistry不计。当前spell_storage优先旧键，spells优先旧spell_0；缺spell_0但有其它旧槽不迁；数字slot解析无局部异常隔离，无clear/范围约束，未知spell null不能认定成功保留。世界库只单向提升obtained/applied，不复制item enabled/selectedSlot/cooldown/stopTime，read重建当前registry而未知条目丢弃；UUID由载荷覆盖且无身份一致核对。实际GUI以obtained显示可选，再toStaff落栈；Imposer花费modifier后资格汇入世界库，施法按选中修饰实际改效果并耗herb。Imbuer先授予后在线消息未判player空，再消耗dust，离线异常可留付费物品但仅静态机制不称复现。LightDrifter cast临时切旁观/免伤/飞行，事件递减期满恢复并删root键，绝不视为永久资格或泛拷Clone。支持方法虽多仅一owner家族，不将音效/registry rename表计数，原生槽位网络与外部NBT API未全读，未开游戏未改生产。
complete_semantic_decision_read.application_limit: SpellLibraryData.generateMap从当前registry设默认未获得，read先重建再按列表覆盖，重复Spell后项覆盖前项；uuid从NBT覆盖构造名UUID却无一致性校验。UUIDRegistry用维度0 lookup缺失新建、clear显式new/dirty/saveAllData；没有Player Clone入口，世界存储同UUID可跨玩家实例查询只是源码结构，不是死亡/末地实际验收。Imbuer持久inserter/progress/完整库存，完成时给该UUID库addSpell，再在线查player发消息未判null；离线授予可能先成功后消息异常而未消费dust，未运行不能称已复现。Imposer与SpellUtil将item资格合并world库，再把world已applied资格补回法杖；未获得条目缺少额外server通用签名验证的安全效果未验。ContainerLibrary有true canInteractWith/可变hand supplier、未展开原生网络槽位校验，不保证客户端任意值可信。独立文件版权文字保留，只借鉴语义不复制。 固定上游源码静态审阅，不直接移植跨版本API，不宣称原生运行验证。未执行上游操作或游戏；固定Roots 1.12.2源码不能替代Dynasty原生验收。

comparisons.distinction: Old staff formats, UUID permanent spell library, modifiers, cost/storage helpers and LightDrifter belong to existing migration owner. No new credit for these. New proposal is Geas live attacker control, ordinary-vs-converted effect removal and its actual feedback consumers, all one family.

migration_overlap_screen.scope: Existing Roots staff/library migration owner exact previously read judgment reused, current equality checked. PetalShell/petal_shell/petal shell metadata search found no named owner; this does not imply every migration source was reread.

whole_chain_observation: Exact earlier native lifecycle, concrete SpellRegistry insertion/finalise, potion registration, client packet registration and actual staff right-click wrapper reused. SpellPetalShell server cast saves modifier snapshot before addPotionEffect and sends burst independently of native effect acceptance. Return true on both sides; usual cast sound/cost/cooldown cannot prove target protection.

Self always receives application attempt. Optional PEACEFUL chooses one random EntityLivingBase in precomputed relative box offset to player block position, filtered with EntityUtil.isFamiliar(player,target), so this owner-specific predicate differs from TimeStop generic familiar skip. No guaranteed candidate, no Boss check, no all-familiar grant. Snapshot replaced before querying old effect.

With CHARGES, calculated shells=maxShells+extraShells is used only when target already has petal_shell. A first application uses maxShells even with CHARGES, both for selected familiar and caster. Native potion combination/admission semantics are external; do not assert every recast exactly overwrites existing stronger effect or accepted duration.

Native HIGHEST LivingHurt onDamage reads current petal effect then server-side computes amplifier-1, removes effect, reads saved modifiers, and if newCount>0 attempts a replacement potion with the full configured duration. It does not preserve remaining duration. Otherwise no replacement. Break/end sound selected solely by newCount, gated by spell sound setting; replacement acceptance not checked.

No local amount>0, unblockable, fire, environmental, trueSource existence or already-canceled guard is required to consume stock once handler is invoked. Earlier Aqua/Storm/TimeStop/Resistance branches can alter/cancel/retaliate within the same method and continue to Petal. Amplifier0/negative still enters presence gate, removes, then refuses. Native event dispatch can filter events before this handler; not claiming every attack reaches it.

After stock removal/replacement, independent modifier if branches attempt radiant/physical/fire damage and poison/levitation/weakness/slow/bleed on trueSource as appropriate. Returned hurt/effect outcomes ignored. Final original event amount0 and canceledtrue occur after retaliation, followed by burst. No explicit retaliatory damage-source exclusion. Normal positive stocks can be depleted through nested calls, but no engine recursion, immortality, exact damage or exception safety guarantee.

Once effect absent the next delivered handler has no Petal gate until recast. Passive duration expiration is native, and complete PotionPetalShell has no removal callback/explicit end sound or snapshot deletion. End sound in EventManager denotes count exhaustion path, not every duration expiry. No stock-regeneration tick, world orphan sweep or saved prior target state.

Potion isReady always true; performEffect server-side obtains current modifier snapshot and sends ring with target ticksExisted, xyz, amplifier and modifier snapshot. Both ring and burst registered clientside. Actual inherited handler queues at client END from previous evidence. No entityID/UUID/dimension/generation/sequence/expiry or current target revalidation; ring is positional snapshot, not authoritative client shield-state storage.

Ring handler computes angle from transmitted amplifier and loops up to locally configured maxShells+optional extra, stopping after decrement count<=0. An incoming count0 is not rejected before division, so infinity/NaN positions can be constructed if such a packet is processed; no malformed packet runtime tested. Negative local shell cap can skip loop. Commented legacy loop is not runtime behavior. Client cap/config and server amplifier may disagree; no exact visual stock guarantee.

Burst packet has same meaning for initial cast and consumed hit: coordinates/modifier snapshot only, no refusal reason/result. First loop ten attempts, second loop random nextInt12 increment can0. No fixed worst-case loop bound claimed. Ring and burst use current world without null check; actual delivery/tracking self inclusion/external MysticalLib internals unverified.

Concrete petal array overload substitutes vz for vx, then scalar no-boolean overload calls smoke helper, which submits LibRegistry.PARTICLE_SMOKE. Both actual ring/burst paths use that overload. Boolean noDepth variant submits registered petal type but is not invoked here. These are read code call-path findings, no asset/pixel evaluation and no new art/particle-policy credit.

ModifierPacket delegates StaffModifierInstanceList snapshot serialization; ISnapshot default toBytes is empty but actual snapshot/list overrides from reused whole files apply. No target identity/result magically added by superclass. Shared staff payment/migration infrastructure0, modifier/color/familiar variants0.
decision: Hold0. Complete native consumed-stock refusal/retaliation already has accepted owners, and effect-instance charge replacement and feedback boundaries also already studied. Immediate replacement with full duration, first-cast extra-shell omission and presentation helper differences are recorded implementation details, not sufficient new independent complete-policy credit. Not a claim that every implementation byte is identical.
critical_boundaries: Fixed Roots1.12.2 commit only. Native potion merge/removal/timer, LivingHurt dispatch/cancellation/recursive damage, matching MysticalLib transport/particle engine are not expanded or executed.
No Boss-specific immune message or ordinary constitution gray text added. Damage refusal, failed application, exhausted resource and visual effect are separate meanings.
No source acquisition, game, Java, Gradle, shared Jar, model/texture/building, master ledger/session/checklist changes. No accepted reference or completed original task claimed.

EventManager and particle smoke full selected methods explicitly reread; other support reused unchanged from042/041, not claimed newly read. Six old semantic decisions read, not their entire upstream chains.
